For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially covered by the template, roll 3 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially covered. For each result of 5+, that Unit suffers an effect depending on the current Phase: • Movement Phase: NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1). • Assault Phase: 1 Dama ge.
